title: Withings Weight and Body-Fat Divergence
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=withings:measure metric=bodycomposition
| bin _time span=30d
| stats first(weight_kg) as start_weight, last(weight_kg) as end_weight, first(body_fat_pct) as start_bf, last(body_fat_pct) as end_bf by person _time
| eval weight_delta=round(end_weight-start_weight,1), bf_delta=round(end_bf-start_bf,1)
| where weight_delta<0 AND bf_delta>0
| sort bf_delta
description: Uses Withings body-composition exports telemetry to monitor whether lower scale weight still came with higher body-fat percentage in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for trend lines that need a closer quality check, not just scale optimism, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Withings body-composition exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly table of weight delta versus body-fat delta.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates whether lower scale weight still came with higher body-fat percentage so you can spot trend lines that need a closer quality check, not just scale optimism before it becomes annoying.
